title: Invoice Preview
summary: Print-ready invoice preview with company logo and address, invoice number and date, 'Invoice To' and 'Bill To' sections, a line items table with item descriptions, costs, quantities, and totals, subtotal/discount/tax breakdown, and a note at the bottom. Right sidebar has action cards for 'Send Invoice' button, 'Download' button, and 'Add Payment' drawer with amount/date/method fields.

layout.columns: Left invoice preview (~70%) as read-only document, right action sidebar (~30%) with send/download/payment cards
